visual.general_description: Grayscale sagittal MRI slice of the lumbar spine in a single unlettered image.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait-format grayscale MR image on a white border with the spine curving from the top centre toward the lower right and the back skin surface along the right edge. In the upper two thirds, vertebral bodies of intermediate gray signal are stacked between thin dark horizontal disc spaces. In the lower portion the regular pattern is disrupted: a rounded dark gray area outlined by thin bright curved lines lies in the vertebral and disc region, with heterogeneous bright and dark signal beside it and a small oval dark structure just to its left. A dark band runs along the posterior margin of the vertebral column, with bright heterogeneous soft tissue behind it. No text, arrows, labels, scale bar or panel letters are printed on the image.

pixel_observations: Single unlabelled grayscale MR image in portrait format with a white border; no printed text, arrows, annotations, scale bar or panel letter is visible.
The spine curves from the top centre toward the lower right and the skin surface of the back runs along the right edge of the image.
In the upper two thirds, vertebral bodies of intermediate gray signal are stacked and separated by thin dark horizontal bands at the disc spaces.

In the lower portion the regular stacked pattern is replaced by an irregular region: a rounded dark gray area outlined by thin bright curved lines lies in the vertebral and disc region, with heterogeneous bright and dark signal beside it.
A small oval dark structure lies just to the left of this irregular region, and a dark band runs along the posterior margin of the vertebral column.
Bright heterogeneous soft tissue lies behind the spine; soft tissue of mixed gray and dark signal occupies the bottom of the image.

visual.general_description: Grayscale axial MRI slice through the lumbar region in a single unlettered image.
visual.detailed_description: Landscape-format grayscale axial MR image on a white border. At the centre is a rounded vertebral body region of heterogeneous intermediate gray signal, with a smoothly marginated rounded darker gray region in its right half bounded by a thin bright curved rim. Behind it lies a rounded dark spinal canal with a thin bright wall between paraspinal muscles of intermediate gray signal. A large sharply defined very dark rounded region lies at the upper left margin and a smaller dark oval structure near the top centre. At the lower right a large oval region of uniform dark gray signal lies within bright subcutaneous tissue. The white letter "H" is printed at the left edge and the white letters "LF" at the right edge beside a vertical bracket ruler with six tick marks and no numbers. No patient name, number, date or panel letter is visible.

pixel_observations: Single unlabelled grayscale axial MR image in landscape format with a white border; no patient name, number, date or panel letter is visible.

A white capital letter "H" is printed at the left image edge at mid height; at the right edge the white letters "LF" sit beside a white vertical bracket ruler with six horizontal tick marks and no numbers.

At the centre is a rounded vertebral body region of heterogeneous intermediate gray signal; a smoothly marginated rounded darker gray region fills its right half and is bounded by a thin bright curved rim.
Behind it, toward the bottom of the image, lies a rounded dark spinal canal with a thin bright wall, flanked by paraspinal muscle of intermediate gray signal.
A large sharply defined very dark rounded region lies at the upper left margin and a smaller dark oval structure lies near the top centre.
At the lower right a large oval region of uniform dark gray signal lies within bright subcutaneous tissue, separated from the skin surface by a thin bright layer.
